race.description: Jeremy Booth Constructions Rising Prince Cup Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BALLET NOIR (2) can assert her class today after producing a sound effort on debut when a fast finishing second over 1250m at Newcastle. Can overcome the awkward gate and take holding out. MACAROON (1) Lonhro mare from the good producing mare Parfaits on debut for the Baker stable. Looked sharp in her latest trial win over 789m at Warwick Farm. Well drawn and expected to go close. THAT'SALLSHEWROTE (8) has impressed in her two runs to date and has genuine claims in this weaker race. Stalked the good speed last time out and failed to finish off when fourth over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Will find this more to her liking and don't dismiss. ORCHID BOY (4) closed off nicely when beaten one length last time on debut at Narromine. Can figure in the finish.
